## Names

<a id="figure_f77_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f77_parts`](../../../../src/graphics/judge_sprites_d000.asm#L6) `$D000`

*data*

VIC pointers $40-$42: frame 77, a small standing figure (slots top left, middle left, bottom left; bottom middle is $4f). No animation script uses frames 77 and 78, so no run shows them. The blocks $d000-$d27f are the v1 blocks $c980-$cbff (v1 pointers $26-$2f) in the same order.

- **Written by:** [`irq_frame_start`](../irq/sprite_mux_plan.md#irq_frame_start) [`$364D`](../../../../src/irq/sprite_mux_plan.asm#L532)

<a id="figure_f78_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f78_parts`](../../../../src/graphics/judge_sprites_d000.asm#L72) `$D0C0-$D1FF`

*data*

VIC pointers $43-$47: frame 78 of the small figure. Frames 77 and 78 are the v1 frames 68 and 69 with new part numbers.
